answers.rationale: The effective_rate relation establishes job J1 at 240 currency units per hour for service code TOW, per the named rate_card rate under service conditions §1.
The effective_rate relation establishes job J4 (ASST) at 180 currency units per hour, billing ASST jobs using the ESCORT rate_card row per service conditions §4.

Seven tow jobs exist but only four (J1–J4) have rows in the billable_hours relation; J5, J6, and J7 lack an established billed_hours quantity (J6 additionally flagged by the blank_billed_hours purpose requirement failure).
The job_charge relation establishes a charge of 2280 for job J2 (8h at 240/hr plus 1h overtime at 1.5×, vessel V-BAY day total 9h > 8 per service conditions §2).
The World contains no relation or assertion establishing a fuel surcharge amount for job J3; job_charge for J3 is based solely on 2h at 120/hr with no surcharge component.

Job J7 is at berth B12 starting at 20:00 (after 18:00). The billing_outcome marks it insufficient_evidence for B12 after-hours towing without emergency documentation, and purpose_requirement_failure records that no emergency log is attached for J7.
